errorCodes.cause: Excessive shutdown — input supply voltage is too low (under 154V)
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect controller power and check if input supply voltage is low (under 154V). If low, restart after voltage returns to normal. If voltage is normal, start controller again — if still fails, replace controller and notify factory.

errorCodes.cause: Running over voltage — input voltage too high (above 264V)
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect controller power, check if input voltage is above 264V. If high, restart after voltage returns to normal. If voltage is normal, replace controller and notify factory.
Turn off system power, reconnect after 30 seconds to check normal operation. Retry several times. If fault occurs frequently, replace controller and inform manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Motor stalled — motor power input plug off/loose/broken, or foreign body wrapped around machine head
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect controller power. Check motor power input plug condition. Check machine head for foreign bodies. Resetting and restarting should resolve. If not, replace controller and inform factory.

errorCodes.cause: Motor Hall signal abnormal — motor sensor connector loose or dropped off
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power. Check if motor sensor connector is loose or dropped off, restore to normal and restart. If still not working, replace controller and notify manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Locator signal abnormal — encoder/positioner plug not connected reliably
errorCodes.solution: Controller automatically switches to non-positioning mode. Check encoder/positioner plug connection. Turn off and on power again. If alarm cannot be eliminated, Hall sensor may be abnormal — contact Maintenance staff. Long press S key to clear E-19 alarm; set P03 to OFF to disable positioning function.

errorCodes.cause: Governor (foot pedal) not plugged in — connector loose or falling off, or pedal is depressed
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power. Check if governor connector is loose or falling off, and that foot pedal is not stepped down. Restore to normal state and restart. Replace controller if still failing.

alarmCodes.cause: Power off or power supply voltage is too low
Motor sleep — machine has been in standby for time set by parameter P55 without running
alarmCodes.solution: Press any key to wake up the machine.

alarmCodes.cause: Flip switch alarm — machine is not in correct position (nose not straight)
alarmCodes.solution: Straighten the nose to ensure flip switch is restored. Press and hold S key to clear alarm and turn off dump detection function.

alarmCodes.cause: Needle signal abnormal — needle replenishment button of machine head may be stuck closed
alarmCodes.solution: Check whether needle replenishment button can be closed and opened normally. If always closed, replace the needle replenishment button. This alarm auto-turns off needle replenishment function but does not affect operation. After 30 seconds, alarm clears automatically or manually by short pressing P key.
